items.title: Topo portable lamp by Felix Pöttinger Design Studio for Maytoni
items.summary: A portable table lamp pairing a cylindrical base with a tiltable disc shade and translucent diffuser, intended to produce layered shadow and reflection effects on its own form.

items.title: Silhouette Awards celebrate five years of mentorship as Season 6 prepares to launch
items.summary: A mentorship and networking programme for emerging lighting designers is entering its sixth season, with the new 2026-2027 programme details to be unveiled at a virtual launch event.

items.title: PLASA Awards for Innovation 2026 winners announced
items.summary: PLASA has announced its 2026 Awards for Innovation winners, recognising new lighting and entertainment technology for safety, efficiency and performance advances.

items.title: Measuring Good Design
items.summary: A Signify executive discusses how the value of illuminated architecture might be assessed and quantified, touching on broader questions of design evaluation in the lighting industry.
